commentary: Nifty's relief bounce snaps a six-week slide, yet internal breadth remains anemic at 49 under a CAUTION regime. With the Nifty Midcap and Smallcap indices lagging (-0.29% and -0.07%), the rally is narrowly sustained by defensives while crude lingers over $100. In Stan Weinstein's framework, an advancing index masking broad-market divergence warns against aggressive capital deployment; William O'Neil's CANSLIM similarly dictates keeping cash levels elevated until genuine accumulation emerges across leading growth names. Strict risk discipline governs this posture: no chasing extended pivots, keeping stops tight, and executing progressive exposure only when verified Stage 2 leaders demonstrate sustained institutional volume and accelerating quarterly earnings.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above key averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on modest 1.21x volume. Relative strength is sluggish, and the price action lacks the tight volatility contraction pattern characteristic of institutional accumulation.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe CANSLIM deterioration: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 56.3% YoY while net profit dropped 25.6%. Sub-par 3% ROE, thin 5.6% ROCE, and razor-thin operating margins (2–3%) highlight weak operational fundamentals despite minimal debt.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails below 94.11 pivot support (-8.7%). Sell decisively on breach to prevent capital erosion.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Constructive Stage 2 structure holding firmly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. The stock formed a double-bottom base with neckline pressure, supported by expanding 1.77x volume and an unextended RSI of 52.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Stellar CANSLIM profile: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue grew 29% YoY with PAT surging 40% YoY, accelerating from Q4 FY26's 30% profit growth. Strong lending expansion, declining credit costs, and healthy capital ratios reflect high institutional sponsorship.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Fails on a close below swing low support at 410.13 (-4.9%). Exit swiftly per Minervini risk rules.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: ABSLLIQUID is an exchange-traded fund tracking overnight TREPS collateral, rendering traditional chart patterns, SEPA breakouts, VCPs, and relative strength metrics completely non-applicable.
ABSLLIQUID.fundamental: Not verified. As a short-term cash management debt ETF, it has no corporate revenues, earnings, operating margins, ROE/ROCE, or CANSLIM growth variables.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Invalid setup if traded for equity appreciation; strictly an overnight cash park yielding repo rates.

ACE.technical: Classic SEPA breakout to fresh 52-week highs on a substantial 2.87x volume expansion. The stock cleanly broke out above its 20-session resistance and all moving averages, displaying standout relative strength against a declining small-cap index.
ACE.fundamental: Strong industrial momentum: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 19.5% YoY with PAT rebounding 22.3% YoY and EBITDA margins expanding above 20.5%. High ROCE (31.6%), negligible debt, and a dominant 63% crane market share support the profile.
ACE.risk: Thesis invalidates if price slips back below the 1,123.57 breakout pivot (-7.5%). Honor stop loss immediately.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Powerful Stage 2 SEPA breakout to new trailing-year highs on 4.89x average volume. Moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) are aligned in an active markup phase, showing institutional demand and superior relative strength.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Rapid top-line expansion: Q1 FY27 revenue jumped 67.8% YoY with net profit up 79.9% YoY, driven by massive project commissioning and battery storage additions. Ongoing debt deleveraging via QIP proceeds supports balance-sheet flexibility.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Breakout fails if price falls below the 394.55 pivot base (-8.4%). Cut losses to maintain asymmetry.

ACUTAAS.technical: Constructive Stage 2 uptrend with price hovering within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Volume is healthy at 1.81x with RSI 58, indicating steady consolidation.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: High-quality specialty chemicals fundamentals: Q1 FY27 revenue climbed 47.3% YoY with PAT rising 67.7%, backed by robust 31.6% ROCE and ~24% ROE. However, YoY EPS expansion slowed from triple digits, capping the setup at Watch under CANSLIM rules.
ACUTAAS.risk: Thesis fails if price drops below 3,495.75 pivot support (-6.6%). Enforce strict stop-loss discipline.
